snippet.title: Shattered Chess - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Chess remixed as a fast roguelike. You get 10 moves to beat a target score by chaining captures into big combos. Build around piece types or mechanics like cooldown, buy/upgrade passives and one-shot effects in the shop, tackle rule-twisting bosses and King Challenges.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4131940/Shattered_Chess/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
